findings.evidence: Current signatures are image-specialized at `RelativeCongr.lean:65` and `RelativeCongr.lean:110`; the generic Mathlib analogue is proof-parametric: `fixingSubgroup_map_conj_eq (hg : g • t = s)` at `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/SubMulAction/OfFixingSubgroup.lean:225` and `fixingSubgroupEquivFixingSubgroup (hg : g • t = s)` at line 252.
findings.fix: Make the main map/equivalence proof-parametric, e.g. `{s : Set M} {t : Set N} (hst : e '' s = t) : fixingSubgroup s ≃* fixingSubgroup t`, and derive the current `e '' s` version as the `rfl` special case.
findings.issue: `relativeDiffCongr` and its helper lemmas target only `fixingSubgroup (e '' s)`, so applications to named relative subsets such as a target boundary require extra `subgroupCongr` plumbing instead of using the theorem directly.

summary: The relative-conjugation API is one step too specialized: it only lands in the literal image subset, while the natural Mathlib-level statement accepts a named target subset with a proof that it is the transported set.
